seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Get in touch with IEEE EMBS at UCF about membership, projects, sponsorship, or collaboration.

hero.headline: Ask us something.
hero.lede: Two ways in, depending on what you need. Neither of them is a contact form.

channels.title: Discord
channels.body: Best for anything small and immediate — how to join, which project to pick, when the next meeting is. Post in the general channel and an officer or a project lead will answer.

channels.title: Email
channels.body: Best for anything that needs a written reply — sponsorship, speakers, equipment, lab collaborations, and questions about IEEE membership or dues. It reaches the officers directly.
